items.title: Humana (HUM) Adds Anthropic And Aflac Veterans To Its Board
items.summary: Humana has elected Paul Smith, Chief Commercial Officer at AI firm Anthropic, to its Board of Directors. The company has also elected Frederick Crawford, formerly President and COO at Aflac, to its Board. Both appointments add technology, insurance and financial expertise at the board level. Humana, traded as NYSE:HUM, is adding additional technology and insurance leadership at a time when its stock has seen a mix of gains and setbacks.
